scope: focused tests and bounded supporting evidence

initialFinding.actual: CLI executable supplied as module package root, so imports resolve under bin/mterm-cli.js/dist/remote/cli.js
initialFinding.resolution: One installedPackageRoot derives the executable and is used for test environment/report; all existing installed checks retained.

priorFindings.evidence: CLI stop selects open/requestStop without config() root-liveness validation; focused regression renames enrolled workspace and confirms owned stop marker.
Inventory returns paired:null with invalid-or-unconfigured status when status metadata cannot be read; it cannot claim a recorded device is unpaired.
discoverRemoteTargets admits namespace/collection directly; inventory-probe is an ordinary entry, invalid files are counted and do not suppress other profiles.
Owned namespace may be mode0755, while private leaf and named collection remain mode0700; writable-by-others ancestors still fail. Legacy v1 state stays unbound and is not rewritten.

Windows reserved collection comparison is case-insensitive and canonical membership is checked too. Named stores require bound scope, including prospective uppercase collection paths. Native Node24 Windows source suite initially passed all1375 tests; installed qualification remained blocked by harness defect.

delta.review: Four-file delta only; verifier path fix plus failure evidence, dated record and matching roadmap fingerprint. No validation weakened.

positiveSecurityReview: Explicit and duplicate/conflicting option validation with environment pinned in generated argv.
Named and DEV state require canonical-directory/environment binding in public config and protected credential payload; copied state/credentials fail cross-scope.
Managed parents and private leaves are admitted with link/owner/permission checks and pinned identities for bound-store operations.
Profile inventory is bounded and reads public local metadata only, with no credential decryption or network access.
Root overlap protects selected state and both managed namespaces before configuration.
Lifecycle actions select one store; tests preserve sibling configuration, credentials and locks byte-for-byte.
Legacy production v1 compatibility preserved for supported owner-controlled namespace; remote/environment default APIs ignore ambient unrelated argv when selecting credentials.
Gateway transport, protocol, adapter, package dependency manifests and production services unchanged.
limits: Local focused verification used Linux Node24.22.1 and owned fixtures; it is not Windows installed-package or live remote enrollment evidence.
The complete first candidate cannot be accepted because package verification aborted; original green source suites do not satisfy its missing installed/native gates.
General profile registry, arbitrary remote MCP servers, provider OAuth, real remote enrollment, deployments and broad issue250 completion are outside this slice.
State-path hardening is not a sandbox against a hostile process with the same OS user.
